itemdesc-claimwand:
Marks out land for a city.
Left click a block - first corner.
Right click a block - second corner.
Sneak + left click - clear.
In hand it shows the plots around: your city in blue, other cities in purple. The selection is green when it can be claimed and red when it cannot.
Squares over plots: red PvP - players may fight, orange F - fire spreads, yellow B - blasts allowed, purple M - no hostile mobs. U, Bu, A - whether you may use, build or attack there: green yes, grey no.
.cxmarkers keeps the squares visible without the wand.
It also shows the borders of city territory around you: your city's in blue, others' in orange. /city borders on keeps them visible without the wand.

gui-prices-explain:
A city holds territory in chunks of {9}×{9} blocks over the whole height: {10} each, once, and {11} a day. A new city comes with its first chunk; an outpost and an extra chunk cost their own price on top of the chunk.

Plots are made inside the territory and counted in units: volume divided by {0} blocks, rounded up, at least one. Making a plot costs units × {1}, once.

Every day the city pays {2}, plus its chunks, plus units × the upkeep of its type for each plot, plus paid flags. When the treasury runs short a debt grows; past {3} the city is dissolved.

Example: {4}×{4}×{4} = {5} blocks = {6} units. Claiming: {7}, a plain plot a day: {8}.
